bulletin                          PURPOSE: This Bulletin clarifies the updated filing requirements for
 TECHNICAL                                 certain electrical installations subject to plan examination
                                           as triggered by the enactment of Local Law 128 of 2024.
ISSUANCE DATE
 August 8, 2025                SUBJECT(S): Electrical work, Electrical filing, Electrical Plan Review (EPR)



   RELATED/SPECIAL INFORMATION: Local Law 128 of 2024

 I. PURPOSE
    The purpose of this bulletin is to clarify electrical work requirements set forth in LL 128 of 2024. Section
    110.2(B) of the 2025 NYC Electrical Code requires electrical plan review (EPR) for certain electrical
    installations. Applicants are required to submit technical documentation to the Department's Electrical
    Plan Review Unit prior to filing for an electrical permit in DOB NOW. These requirements differ from
    those of 1 RCNY 4000-01 and this rule will be updated to coincide with the effective date of the 2025
    NYC Electrical Code.


 II. ELECTRICAL WORK REQUIREMENTS
    To support the consistent and efficient review of submissions, the Department has issued a companion
    guide entitled: Electrical Work Guide for the 2025 NYC Electrical Code. This guide outlines the required
    contents, format, and review criteria for electrical plan review filings. Refer to the Electrical Work
    Guidance Document.
    The document can be found at www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/elect_work_guidance.pdf.
